parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of a folding knife made of stainless steel, typically sharp and durable.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for cutting, slicing, or piercing materials. It rotates or folds into the handle for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around a pivot point to open or close relative to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of aluminum alloy for lightweight strength.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable grip and houses the pivot mechanism for the rotation blade.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blade rotates around its pivot point.
